summary: better-auth 1.7 requires account.issuer (NOT NULL) plus a unique index on (issuer, accountId); the first cut of the admin schema migration omitted both, so admin:create failed
evidence: could not create operator: column "issuer" of relation "admin_account" does not exist — from auth.api.signUpEmail. Same requirement services/web retrofitted onto public.account in 1787189370526_add_account_issuer. Fixed in-place (the migration was unmerged and unshipped) and round-tripped down/up; the credential account now lands with issuer='local:credential'.

summary: the field comparison reported false differences on every published recipe: createdAt/updatedAt compared byte-for-byte, and fields neither copy set were labelled 'network only'
evidence: Screenshot of /network/recipes/$did/$rkey showed 'Created at | 2026-08-01T10:00:00.000Z | 2026-08-01T10:00:00Z | differs' — Postgres re-prints a timestamptz with milliseconds while the record carries whatever the publishing client wrote. Separately, statusFor() fell through to 'network-only' when BOTH sides were null, so 8 empty optional fields read as network-side values the local copy was missing — exactly backwards. Fixed: timestamp-kind paths compare parsed instants (unparseable falls back to literal, so a malformed timestamp is still a finding); 'absent' is now its own status and is hidden by 'Only differences'. Pinned by 11 tests in src/lib/record-shape.test.ts including the 1 vs 01 case that a general date-coercion test would have gotten wrong.
